classes.description: A differential-drive ground robot: it drives straight, turns on the spot and goes to a pose on a map. Spec 30.

pose_x_mm.description: Position on the map's x axis. Absent when the robot is not localised.

pose_y_mm.description: Position on the map's y axis. Absent when the robot is not localised.

pose_theta_mdeg.description: Heading, counter-clockwise from the map's x axis. Absent when the robot is not localised.

localized_at_ms.description: When the pose was last fixed, by the robot's clock. Absent when the robot is not localised.

linear_velocity_mm_s.description: Measured speed along the heading; negative backwards.

motion_state.description: idle: the last motion ended; moving; stopped: halted by robot.stop; estopped: the emergency stop is pressed.

obstacle_detected.description: Something is in the robot's protective field.

emergency_stop.description: The hardware emergency stop is pressed.

resource_limits.geofence: required: a convex polygon in mm, in the map frame; every motion stays inside it
resource_limits.max_localization_age_ms: required: a motion needs a pose fixed no longer ago than this
resource_limits.envelope: required: an upper bound on every motion's speed parameter (speed_mm_s, speed_mdeg_s)
